purpose: First PyTorch training-loop baseline on the same 14 raw features; not a promised production replacement

refit.epochs: selected best epoch; new model, optimizer and train-fitted preprocessing

development_evaluation: 2018 once after refit; already-observed development period, not independent final test
raw_features: same 14 MODEL_COLUMNS as classical first experiment, including channel
preprocessing: same signed-log, imputation, scaling and one-hot policy as LR; fit only respective fit period; dense float32 after memory check
output: one logit; no sigmoid before BCEWithLogitsLoss
shuffle: training batches only; never mix period membership
evidence_required: trusted local state_dict reload prediction consistency
limitations: Checkpoint selection uses only 63 correlated positives in two months; unstable and not final validation.
One seed, one architecture; no automatic neural superiority claim.
Feature channel retained for matched-input baseline despite known risk; any later ablation must be a new recorded experiment.
PyTorch package version and installer provenance must be recorded before execution.
